column1: # Names for tools/fwsrc.py: `addr name [where documented]`. A name replaces Ghidra's
# FUN_/D_ label at that address; whether it is a function comes from src/layout.tsv.
# Only names backed by docs/*.md; docs/source-map.md lists every function.
# Vector handlers use the CMSIS names.
0800e1f8 app_construct                  builds the object graph, reads settings and patches
# --- runtime libraries: libstdc++, newlib-nano and its syscall stubs (firmware-map.md Runtime libraries)
0801eee8 _write                         returns the length: printf output is dropped
080267a0 printf                         5 debug messages for input events, firmware-map.md
08027bd9 pad_levels                     16 levels 0..127 for pads (glide, velocity LEDs)
# --- every other function, by source file (source-map.md)
0802941c calib_table                    50 steps x 0x20: word ptr, limits, type, step, setup, finish
